ModMetaData.name: Break Loyalty
ModMetaData.author: JalapenoLabs
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Break Loyalty ceremony: a ritual that can shatter a prisoner's unwavering loyalty to their faction, opening the door to recruitment.
A speaker addresses the prisoner before an audience. The chance of success is deliberately low and capped at 25%, raised by the speaker's social skill, spectators, the prisoner's disillusionment with their own faction, shared ideoligion, bonds with your colonists, and the prisoner's contentment. A colony-wide cooldown of five days keeps it from being spammed, and a failed ceremony leaves the prisoner resentful.
Requires the Ideology DLC.
